layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — patience beats impulse right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a fearful state with a Fear & Greed index of 26 and worsening. Bitcoin dominance at 56.5% means money is flowing away from altcoins and toward Bitcoin, which makes altcoin swing trades riskier. Most candidates on the watchlist are either already overbought after recent rallies (KAITO at RSI 83, Q at RSI 77) or have terrible risk/reward ratios. The best approach is to wait for a cleaner setup rather than force a trade in unfavorable conditions.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. If Ethereum drops to the $1,800 support level with rising volume, that could be a strong entry point. Don't chase coins that have already pumped 20-30% this week.
expert_reasoning: Systematic review of all 10 candidates reveals no high-conviction swing entry. KAITO (RSI 83) and Q (RSI 77) are overbought — per validated rules, RSI is our most reliable signal at 83% win rate, and overbought readings are a clear avoid. DEXE dropped 89.7% in 7 days which looks like a structural break, not a bounce candidate. SHIB and BONK already pumped 30% and 13% respectively. MORPHO has a 0.25x R/R ratio — per Rule #9, trades below 0.5x R/R should be downgraded to HOLD. ETH is the cleanest candidate with RSI 41, stable price action, and $1,800 support — but at current price ($1,880) the R/R is only 0.34x, making immediate entry unfavorable. The correct play is to wait for a pullback to $1,800 support where R/R improves to ~1.0x.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed at 26 and worsening could push to Extreme Fear territory, triggering further market-wide selloffs
BTC dominance at 56.5% actively suppresses altcoin performance — this headwind persists until rotation occurs
No funding rate data available for any candidate, reducing conviction on positioning dynamics
watch_list: ETH price action at $1,800 support — a bounce with volume would trigger a BUY signal
Fear & Greed index — if it drops below 20 (Extreme Fear), contrarian buy opportunities may emerge
BTC dominance trend — a reversal below 55% would signal the start of altcoin rotation
market_context: The crypto market is in a fear state (26/100, worsening trend) with Bitcoin dominance high at 56.5%, creating a hostile environment for altcoin swing trades. Most altcoins are either already extended from recent pumps or stuck in bearish structures.
context_banner: Market fear and high BTC dominance create a 'wait for better entry' environment — discipline over impulse.
